findings.title: No automated tests
findings.why: Your daily-ship definition requires a passing test. Without one, nothing proves it still works.
findings.prompt: demo_game has no automated tests (checked branch `main`). Add a minimal test suite for its core behavior using the stack's standard runner — at least one end-to-end test of the main path — plus the command to run it in the README. Open a PR.

findings.title: No CI
findings.why: Tests that only run when someone remembers are tests that stop running.
findings.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow to demo_game that installs from a clean checkout and runs the tests on every push and PR. Use pinned action versions. Open a PR.

findings.title: README doesn't say how to run it
findings.why: Running from a clean clone requires knowing the commands. Future-you is a stranger.
findings.prompt: Update demo_game's README with: one-line purpose, prerequisites, exact commands to install, run and test from a clean clone, and where it's deployed (if anywhere). Verify the commands actually work. Open a PR.

findings.why: Every session starts cold without it — conventions, commands and decisions get re-discovered each time.
findings.prompt: Create a CLAUDE.md for demo_game: purpose, layout, how to run and test, conventions, key decisions, and what not to touch. Keep it under 80 lines and grounded in the actual code. Open a PR.
